dimensions.title: Hörförståelse
dimensions.summary: Understand clear, simple spoken Swedish in common everyday situations, including short retellings, conversations, adapted news, messages and instructions.

dimensions.title: Läsförståelse
dimensions.summary: Read and understand simple texts used in everyday life, including adapted narrative and descriptive texts, concrete information, short messages and instructions.

dimensions.title: Muntlig interaktion
dimensions.summary: Take part, with support, in simple conversations about familiar topics; express and respond to statements, opinions and wishes, and ask and answer questions so the conversation is partly maintained.

dimensions.title: Muntlig produktion
dimensions.summary: Use simple Swedish, with support, to talk about personal experiences and familiar people, places and events in an understandable and partly connected way.

dimensions.title: Skriftlig färdighet
dimensions.summary: Write simple, understandable texts for everyday communication, such as short messages, greetings and texts about oneself and experienced events, with mainly functional coherence.
